steps.title: Identify XML Namespace Error
steps.description: Inspected the AndroidManifest.xml file and detected an invalid xmlns:android namespace URL pointing to 'schemas.github.com' instead of 'schemas.android.com'.

steps.title: Correct AndroidManifest.xml Schema URL
steps.description: Modified the xmlns:android attribute in the root <manifest> element to the standard 'http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android' namespace.

steps.title: Building Study Planner Pro
steps.description: Trigger the Gradle build system using the correct Android namespace to package the APK successfully.
